transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Carlos, our current provider NetCom just got acquired by MegaCorp. We're concerned about service changes and potential price increases. What options do we have?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand your concern. Acquisitions often lead to service disruptions and policy changes. We can provide stability with our independent ownership and proven track record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's exactly what we're worried about. We need assurance that our service levels won't change and pricing will remain predictable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As an independent company, we offer long-term contract stability with locked pricing and SLA guarantees. We've never been acquired and have no plans for ownership changes.
